# Visionary Nexus — Agent Network

## CORE IDEA
Agents are not isolated.
They operate as a coordinated intelligence network.

---

## 1. SYSTEM FLOW MODEL

Input → Router Agent → Specialized Agents → Output Layer → System Feedback

---

## 2. ROUTER LOGIC

A central routing layer determines:
- which agent receives the task
- task priority level
- execution order

---

## 3. COLLABORATION RULE

Agents can:
- pass tasks to other agents
- request validation from other agents
- refine outputs through iteration loops

No agent works in isolation.

---

## 4. TASK DISTRIBUTION

### Example Flow

User Request →
→ Analyzer Agent (interpretation)
→ Builder Agent (structure creation)
→ Automation Agent (execution logic)
→ Security Agent (validation)
→ Output finalized

---

## 5. FEEDBACK LOOP

- Every output is reviewed by system logic
- Errors are logged as improvement signals
- System evolves based on repeated patterns

---

## 6. NETWORK PRINCIPLE

Visionary Nexus is a distributed intelligence system.
No single agent controls the system.
Control is emergent, not centralized.
